lifecycle.order: stages lower to ordinary finite Run Graph nodes and explicit control edges; no stage runtime branch
lifecycle.activation: all control milestones AND verified bindings AND current node admission; applied satisfies accepted; no hoisting
lifecycle.failure: unit-wide success barrier; unknown reconciles; explicit general failure/token routing remains legal
lifecycle.publication: all local Results; graph output index references existing artifacts; no second Invocation
lifecycle.extraction: lower_stages and load(extract_stage_programs) have identical canonical typed graph and common execution laws
lifecycle.commit: common commit scope before capture; final valid accepted requires no undeclared provider completion

identity.definition: typed stable Program/node namespace and complete local body, used declarations, import interfaces, incoming gates; no parent revision or position
identity.observation: local Invocation binds local definition, effective values, contract closure and exact required observations/issuer/policy/provenance
identity.recovery: logical request/item locator before exact Preview dispatch key; physical Run identity excluded transitively
identity.self_cid: canonical AoA JSON without self_cid; referenced evidence must resolve with kind, scope and semantic validation
identity.authentication: detached authentication signs payload CID excluding self_cid and authentication_evidence_cid; verify pinned issuer and algorithm
identity.success: graph_success precedes output index and final graph receipt; it cannot reference either future artifact
identity.membership: global Program/lock/revision/Run links are separately authenticated; no transitive ancestry into local Preview/review/locator/dispatch
identity.keys: target and item reuse existing typed values; new runtime keys are stable locator and exact dispatch; fingerprint detects changed intent

admission.schema: JSON Schema is necessary, not sufficient; no incoming artifact normalization or default insertion
admission.stage: unique stage IDs, prior-only imports, exact exports and contracts, immutable parameters and engine pins
admission.ledger: fencing; same key/different request rejects; absent history does not prove initial dispatch
admission.authorization: authenticated human/policy proposition; template eligibility and concrete substitution separate
admission.numeric: finite number or typed empty NULL; exact contributors/count/group/filter; replay never recomputes
admission.model: ok requires typed value, real response and response issuer; failure has no typed value, optional actual error response and mandatory outcome evidence; no response is null, not empty bytes; strict publishes no Relation
admission.normalization: raw_count = normalized_count + excluded_count; first_by_order requires independent total order
admission.completion: failed/cancelled/expired is not completed success; non-null results require availability and original OperationRef contract proof
admission.exceptional_commit: separate operator claim, exact fenced state/batch/unmet list and generation CAS; cancelled/timed_out/budget_exhausted/rejected preserve original outcome and all item evidence; unknown/accepted_pending descendants require durable handoff, never abandonment or success relabeling
admission.classification: published default only for absent label; invalid/unmapped/conflicting policy rejects; issuer/Ref/capture policy agrees without relabeling
admission.stamp: declared recipe/management writes plus business permissions and footprint; current denial means zero writes; overwritten last_stamp is not not_applied proof
admission.routing: closed semantic facts, no AST/meta/count proxies; cumulative actual risk not reset per node; packaging alone cannot add review
admission.derive: map snapshot/add-only, array prior-slot/input-preserving shadow, unique NFC outputs; common row frame and budgets; select closes fields
